criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 2, 6, 3 and 4 hold a dark field and a pool. 7 is a beige floor meeting black at a hard horizon with fans 1.55 to 1 on screen against 2.17 and an aliased shadow; 8's mid-tone wood and a leader through a glyph; 5's limb across the leg; 9's riser notch and oversized board; 1's grey body.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One key and both devices work; 7 sits outside the dark register.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: No hard fail; every numeral traces; slide 3's three trays as one reviewer's choices is a loose inference.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who decides and where land; no deadline or next date.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Follows the human loop; 7 does not land the share; 4 and 9 overlap.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and local; 'at frame 6's scale' and the illustration disclosure read as machinery.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A clear change from nos. 69 and 70.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A void floor, slab-like fans not proportional to 39 to 18, an aliased shadow.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Proportional stride, a tight pool so the asphalt falls to black, labels above their fans.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mid-tone wood, flat folders, a leader through a glyph, cylinder stubs.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Labels on one baseline, narrow the key, remove the stubs.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin officer and a limb across his leg.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the limb, turn his head to the pile, move the tires into the key.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Riser notch and an oversized board.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Fill the notch and scale the notice to letter size in both hands.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey body fills the bottom 45 percent.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull the key onto the rail edge so the panels fall to near black.
